content.title: First Time Visit Guide - Ruth's Chris Steak House Richmond
content.text: First Time Visitor’s GuideTo Ruth’s ChrisTips for First-Time GuestsIs this your first time visiting Ruth’s Chris? Welcome. We look forward to meeting you. Whether you’re celebrating one of life’s special moments or looking to treat yourself on a weeknight, we’re ready to serve you.The first thing you should know is that this guide is unnecessary. Our founder Ruth believed that the experience of dining at a steak house shouldn’t be intimidating. Visiting Ruth’s Chris is about us providing you with mouthwatering steaks, incredible service, and uncompromising hospitality. You don’t have to do a thing except sit back and enjoy.With that said, we’ve compiled a few tips that may make your visit more enjoyable.“Life’s too short to eat anywhere else.”Ruth FertelFounderMaking ReservationsReservations for the Ruth’s Chris main dining room are highly recommended. You can make reservations from our website or you can also call the restaurant directly.If you’re celebrating an anniversary, birthday, or any other occasion, let us know when you make your reservation so we can be sure to add some special touches to make your night a memorable one. It is not an imposition for us and frankly helps us serve you better.Reservations are not required at our bar, where seating is on a first-come, first-served basis. The full Ruth’s Chris menu is available in our bar, and the service is just as excellent.Planning Your TimeA leisurely, multi-course dinner at Ruth’s Chris lasts a little less than two hours. If you have plans and need to make it quicker, just let your server know and we’ll be happy to accommodate you. You are, of course, welcome to stay as long as you like.What to WearProper attire for dining at Ruth’s Chris ranges from upscale business casual to elegant. You might see guests in everything from slacks and a nice top to a cocktail dress or suit and tie. In an effort to maintain a family-friendly environment, we kindly ask guests to refrain from wearing clothing with offensive graphics or language. Additionally, caps, exposed undergarments, cut-off shorts, tank tops or clothing emitting marijuana odor are not considered appropriate attire and will not be allowed in any area of the restaurant. Team jerseys and sportswear are welcome in the bar or on the patio only. Choosing a WineDon’t worry if you don’t know a Cabernet from a Chardonnay! You don’t need to be a wine expert to enjoy wine at Ruth’s Chris . Our goal is to make your dining experience as enjoyable and simple as possible, so all you need to bring is your sense of taste and adventure.Our servers are experts in our wine collection and are more than happy to guide you in finding the perfect pairing for your meal. They are well-versed in understanding the nuances of our wine list and can recommend a bottle or glass based on your preferences and your chosen meal. They’re here to help you navigate the world of wine, so feel free to ask them any questions you might have.We offer our wines both by the bottle and by the glass, allowing you the flexibility to savor and explore different flavors throughout your meal. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion with a bottle, or simply enjoying a glass with your meal, we’ve got you covered.Private Events and Large PartiesRuth’s Chris is the perfect place to host large parties and celebrations. We have private event rooms which can be arranged in various configurations to support events ranging from large birthday parties to training sessions. On top of everything else, our events are completely turnkey — our private event specialist will help you arrange every detail of your event.If you’d like to explore hosting an event at Ruth’s Chris, please visit our Private Events planning page.What to know before you goRestaurant’s terms and conditionsProper attire required: Business Casual to Elegant. Please avoid sleeveless shirts, hats, athletic wear, overly revealing clothing, exposed undergarments, offensive graphics, or clothing with marijuana odor. Management reserves the right to refuse service to those inappropriately dressed. A 20% gratuity is added for separate checks and parties of 5+. Please use electronic devices with earbuds or on silent, and kindly manage children to ensure a pleasant experience for all. Thank you.Important dining informationWe have a 15 minute grace period. Please call us if you are running later than 15 minutes after your reservation time.We may contact you about this reservation, so please ensure your email and phone number are up to date.A note from the restaurantFor parties of 5 or more, the entire group must be present to be seated. If fewer party members arrive within a 15-minute grace period, your reservation may be adjusted to the number of guests present, and seating will be accommodated accordingly. Please note that guests arriving after our last seating time may not be guaranteed entry or service. The host is responsible for ensuring all guests know our dress code policy.“All you have to do here is be you, unless you’re no fun.”Ruth FertelFounder
